book.name: APOCALIPSIS
book.title: JA' TZET AK'BIL CAN YOTAJNE EL NAJ JUAN YU JESUCRISTO

content: Jix lawi tu', catu' jix xu'on strompeta jun yet sjo' ángel tu'. Catu' jix wilon an, ey xa ec' jun weycan titnaj can satcan yiban tx'otx'. Jix ak'le slaweal jun xab jolan tol c'am yich tet jun weycan tu'.
Catu' eyman jix sjaj jun xab tu'. Jix c'oli yaol muc' yul jun xab tu', jaxca ya smuc'al junoj miman horno. Jix k'ejbi c'u yetoj satcan yu jun muc' tu'.
Ec'al wan no' nok' jaxca no' k'ul jix eyol xol muc' tu'. Jix sajlemtoj no' yul yiban k'inal. Jix ak'le yipal wan no' tu' ẍi'wa jaxca chi yun ẍi'wa no' sinam yet yul yiban k'inal ti'.
Jix al-le tet no' tol manchej yetnetoj an chim no', yetoj tzettaj yetal yax cultaj chi ch'ibi, c'al te' te'. Asan eb ánima man ey oj oc sello Dios yin spalan, asan eb chi ske' ẍi'le yu no'.
Ma ak'le yak' cam junoj ánima no'. Pero jix ale oc sya'ilal yin eb ánima yin joeb xaaw yu no'. Ja' jun sya'il chi yak' no' tu', caw laan jaxca bey chi ẍi no sinam.
Ja' yet jun tiempoal tu', oj sey ec' ánima tzet utbil chi yun scami, pero man oj ilcha tzet utbil oj yun scam eb. Cax c'al caw chi yoche eb chi cami, pero man oj cam pax eb.
Ja' wan no' jaxca no' k'ul tu', watx' xa ye no' jaxca no' che, watx' xa ye sto yin jowal. Ey a jun tzet yetal jaxca oro corona yu no' yin sjolom. Laan yili sat no' jaxca sat ánima.
Ja' xil no', laan jaxca xil ya' ix. Ja' ye no', laan jaxca ye no' león.

Ey jun tzet yetal ey oc yin smimanil jaxca ch'en ch'en pichile chi yaoc eb soldado. Laan wal snilili xic' no' jaxca snililial sbilwi wan carreta tok'bil yu jayc'on oj no' che chi yak' ani sto yin jowal.
Ey suup sne no' jaxca no' sinam. Ja' suup no' tu', ey yip yetnen ánima yin joeb xaaw.
Ja' yul jun xab, ja' tu' jix aol jun ángel ey oc yaawil oj no' nok' tu'. Ja' yaawil no' tu', Abadón sbi yin hebreo. Jal yin griego xin, Apolión sbi. Chi yal yel oc apnoj q'ueywawom.
Jaxca ton ti' jix yun yec' jun babel sya'ilal. Pero ey to caab xa tol to oj jul oj.
Jix xu' strompeta jun yet swaj ángel tu'. Ja' jun smeẍail xaambal oro ey ec' sattaj Dios, ja' xiquinlaj jaxca yuc'a' yili. Ja' snan xol caneb xiquin tu', jix wab yoc jun aw.
Jix yal jun aw tu' tet jun yet swaj ángel tu' jaxca ti': —Jaj el canwan eb ángel pixan bey sti' ja' ja' miman Eufrates, ẍi tet eb.

Catu' jix to jajle el eb ángel tu' scanwanil yu eb. Catu' jix to eb mak'o cam ánima. Ja' jun yet yox tujan eb ánima jix ak'le cam yu eb bey sat tx'otx'. Yu ton jun yorail tu', jun c'ual tu', jun xaawil tu', jun jabil tu', yuxan jix ak'le yak'le lista sba eb ángel tu'.
Catu' jix waben sbisil eb soldado ey a yiban no' che chi colwa smulna yetoj eb ángel tu', tol caab ciento millón eb.

Yin weyiche c'al jix wute wilon no' ẍe eb tu'. Ja' eb ey a yiban no' che tu', ey oc jun jun ch'en smajil oj xam sc'ul jun jun eb, cajin, yaxin, c'al k'an yili ch'en. Laan sjolom no' ẍe eb tu' jaxca sjolom no' león, chi eltej k'ak' yetoj muc' c'al azufre yul sti' no' ẍe eb tu'.
Ja' jun yet yox tujan eb ánima jix can bey tx'otx' tx'otx' ti' jix cam yu oxeb sya'ilal chi eltej yul sti' ẍe eb tu', k'ak' k'ak' tu', muc' tu', yetoj azufre tu'.
Ja' wan no' tu', ja' yin sti' eb ey oc yipal, yetoj yin sne eb. Ja' sne eb tu', ey sjolom jaxca laba. Caw chi yetne eb ánima no' yetoj sne tu'.

Pero ja' eb ánima ma cam yu wan sya'ilal tu', c'am nioj jix sna' sba sc'ul eb yin spenail chi el yuneni. Ma sbej eb yalon sba tet eb pena espíritu. C'am pax chi sbej yalon sba eb tet tzet chi al-le oc diosal, wan chi swa'ne eb yetoj ch'en oro, yetoj ch'en plata, c'al yetoj ch'en bronce, c'al yetoj ch'en ch'en c'al te' te'. Ja' wan ch'en dios, c'al te' dios tu', c'am chi ilwi eb, c'am pax chi yab eb, c'am pax chi ske' sbey eb.
Ja' xol eb ánima tu', ey eb mak'om cam ánima, ey eb atxum. Ey eb mulwom, ey pax eb elk'om. Pero c'am nioj jix sna' sba eb yin spenail.
